segments.narration: Hi. I am Aman, competing solo in Hack Nation seven, track two, the RealPage rental housing law challenge.
If you manage rentals, the hard part is not reading one law. It is knowing which city, county, and state rules apply to one address on one date when your building facts might be incomplete.

I built LeaseLaw Navigator. You enter an address and a date. The app shows what applies, what is not in effect yet, and what we cannot decide without more information. Every answer links to the original law text. It is not legal advice.
Five hundred starter addresses, fifty extracted rules, and five of five automated change tests. The demo video walks the live site. The technical video covers extraction, matching, and deploy.
